drafts.email1:
Hi Jamie,

I came across NCT06752356 — your Phase 3 study of Immune globulin (human) 10% solution for intravenous administration in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy, and wanted to reach out.

Phase 3 programmes are on the submission runway, and the clinical pharmacology package — PopPK, E-R, DDI, special populations — is typically on the critical path. For Immune globulin (human) 10% solution for intravenous administration in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy, delivering these analyses right the first time is what avoids information requests and keeps the review timeline on track. With 161 patients generating a rich dataset, this is the point where a well-executed clinical pharmacology package can keep the PDUFA date on track, or a gap in the analysis can trigger an information request that costs months.

Our team at PumasAI — pharmacometricians and clinical pharmacologists, several from FDA, Pfizer, and BMS — has delivered 40+ regulatory submissions across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and Health Canada, all accepted on first review. We handle the full clinical pharmacology programme end-to-end: PopPK, exposure-response, DDI, special populations, QTc, regulatory writing, and agency interactions through submission.

Given the 9-country footprint, you'll need PK/PD packages that satisfy each agency's expectations — that's something we do routinely across multi-regional programmes.

I also noticed Kedrion has an active programme in Hematology (Phase 3) — if there's a clinical pharmacology need there as well, happy to discuss.

Would a short call make sense to see if there's a fit? Happy to share a relevant case study from a similar Phase 3 Dermatology programme beforehand.
drafts.subject2: Re: NCT06752356 — Clinical Pharmacology Submission Package
drafts.fu1:
Hi Jamie,

Wanted to follow up briefly on my earlier note about NCT06752356.

Regulatory reviewers increasingly expect MIDD-supported dose justification in Phase 3 submissions. We've prepared packages that went through FDA review with zero clinical pharmacology queries for Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy programmes — worth a conversation?

We recently delivered a complete clinical pharmacology submission package for a Phase 3 programme where our PopPK and E-R analyses directly addressed an FDA information request, keeping the PDUFA date on track — happy to share a short write-up if it'd be useful context for your team. No pitch, just the technical detail.

Would it be worth 15 minutes to see if the timing works for Kedrion?
drafts.fu2:
Hi Jamie,

I know your inbox is full — this will be my last note on NCT06752356.

If a need for the clinical pharmacology submission package for Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy, regulatory interactions, or agency meeting preparation arises, PumasAI is here.

Wishing you and the Kedrion team every success with NCT06752356.
